thread:
Rina: Quick ask  we need a compact 'bench story' asset set for the Apr 28 inbound campaign: hero stat card (wide), 3 social crops, and a single-slide benchmark explainer for sales. Can design take this?
Marco: Yes. What single stat should lead?
Rina: Lead with 'median latency 72ms' and 'estimate $0.07/1k tokens' as supporting. Callouts: 'predictable economics' + 'unified runtime'. Keep hero headline <= 9 words.
Vera: Copy constraints: no absolutes, include data footnote linking to CSV, alt text required, use core palette only.
Legal: Confirmed. Replace any 'lowest' or 'fastest' claims. Add footnote: "Benchmark results vs open baseline; see data." Link scope doc: https://legal.redwood/claims-guidance.pdf
Marco: Visual direction: single stat in large type, small sparkline beneath showing stable latency, icon for cost. No drop shadows, Inter var font. Export: PNG 1200x675, 1080x1080, and PPTX slide.
Design-bot: New Figma file created by Marco: "benchstory-apr28" https://figma.com/file/benchstory-apr28 node=3
Rina: Inbound mapping: set source=bench_apr28 and hidden field bench_variant. Route leads to queue "bench-webinar". Ops please confirm.
Ops: Confirmed. APAC leads to apac-sdr, others to bench-webinar.
Marco: Timeline: first comps by Tue midday, final assets by Thu EOD for localization. I'll ping when drafts are in Figma.
Rina: Copy options (short):
- "Ship predictable inference at scale. Register Apr 28."
- "See inference that balances cost and latency. Live demo Apr 28."
Vera: I'll prepare alt text and localization notes once assets are ready.
Rina: Thanks  tagging @Legal for one last sweep when mock is ready. :thumbsup:
Legal: Will review when Marco posts the Figma link.
Marco: Dropping draft in Figma now, will post final export to /marketing-assets/bench_apr28 after approvals.
